content.comment_body: I have two more questions: - Is it possible to store the setpoint in memory so that it remains after turning the device off and back on? - Thank you [user_name]
A new question from [user_name] was moved to a separate thread with the topic: 'If I press F1, I want to go to a specific screen for settings – is this achievable?' Best regards [user_name]

If you write a value directly to a parameter of a block using the operator device (such as through a basic panel), the value will be retained after the device is powered off. These parameter values are stored in flash memory.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are seeking clarification about whether the [product_name] device retains setpoint data following a power cycle. It was explained that if values are entered directly into a parameter block (for example, via an operator panel interface), they are saved in flash memory and persist through power interruptions, which improves reliability and usability.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect that the device will retain setpoint values in memory, even when turned off and back on.
pain_keywords: risk of data loss after power cycling
